name: SYN Flood
description: One source IP sends more than 100 TCP SYN packets per second (averaged over 5 seconds) to port 443.

name: Distributed SYN Flood
description: All sources together send more than 300 TCP SYN packets per second (averaged over 5 seconds) to port 443.

name: Packet Rate Flood
description: One source IP sends more than 1000 packets per second (averaged over 5 seconds) to port 443.
